rationale: At rest the nav text is #1a1a1a on #ffffff (17.40:1, pass). On :hover the text becomes #8a8a8a on #ffffff = 3.452:1, which fails the 4.5:1 requirement for normal text.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3: "The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except: Large Text ... at least 3:1; Incidental ... Logotypes."

rationale: The white banner text is on solid #1a5fc4 at rest (6.04:1, pass). On :hover the background becomes a linear-gradient ending at #c0d8f5, where white text is only 1.46:1 (fail). The truth is a fail, but a flat-color reducer cannot resolve a gradient to a single background and must abstain.
citation: Failure F83: "Failure of Success Criterion 1.4.3 ... due to using background images that do not provide sufficient contrast with foreground text (or images of text)."

citation: Failure F83: "Failure of Success Criterion 1.4.3 ... due to using background images that do not provide sufficient contrast with foreground text (or images of text)."

rationale: The :visited color is #b9a3dd on #ffffff = 2.247:1, which is low by raw ratio, but SC 1.4.3 explicitly excepts text changed to indicate a visited link. The visited-only color drop is therefore exempt and counts as passed for 1.4.3.
citation: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 / 1.4.3 visited exception: "Color is not used as the only visual means ... excludes text that is changed to indicate it is a 'visited' link."
